_about: Extra data merged into site/data.js by build_data.py. Sources: PowerPyx Full Walkthrough (character locks) and PowerPyx Trophy Guide (trophy list + tiers), both 18 Nov 2026.

characterLocks._note: Mission # from the Story Missions sheet -> character the mission is locked to. Used only when the sheet's Character column is empty.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
A Long Road
trophies.tip: Earned automatically when this tracker hits 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.tip: Any mix of jumps, bridges, knife flights and base jumps. Under the Bridges are quickest.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.desc: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.tip: 42 gold medals; also needed for 100%.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.desc: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.tip: 14 locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.tip: 40 unique races exist; 30 are needed for 100% anyway.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.desc: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.tip: 9 types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, video game, a race, a stunt.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.desc: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.tip: Potentially missable: do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house in Chapter 1.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.tip: Landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags all count.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.tip: Earned automatically from the Challenges tab.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.tip: Scan passing traffic with the WAiNK app.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.tip: Unfog the whole map; a plane is fastest.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.desc: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.tip: One per gang (9 gangs).

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.tip: Unlocks after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.desc: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.tip: A large bank vault robbery counts.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.desc: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.desc: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.tip: Cal texts you after Feng Shui (Chapter 1).

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.tip: Lucia only, from Chapter 3.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.tip: Clear all 7 shipwrecks for Kenton.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.tip: Unlocks after Coffee Break (Chapter 2).

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.desc: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.tip: Only some count: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.tip: Deliver all 16 cars on Randy's Wish List.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.tip: Jason only.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.desc: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.tip: Jason only; part of Bret's target decks.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.tip: Finish every level of any one video game; three are playable on your home TV.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.desc: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.tip: Comes naturally from bank vault robberies.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.desc: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.desc: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.tip: Gang operation enemies work; police and soldiers reportedly don't.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.desc: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.tip: Steal a passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge and fly 1 km away.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.tip: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.desc: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.tip: Use the Snap Gun, crack the safe, wipe the footage and disable the alarm.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.desc: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.tip: Apple Martini at the Ocean View rooftop bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.desc: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.tip: The blue Banshee in the south Vice City showroom, through the window.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.desc: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.tip: Take all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, then escape.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.tip: Max strength on both Jason and Lucia.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.tip: 500 criminal-profile actions; usually comes naturally.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.tip: Not confirmed yet; possibly the Prologue Payday Loans store.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.tip: UFO easter egg near the Starlet Motel after 2 AM, solo.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.desc: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.tip: Not confirmed yet; possibly kicking enemies from a motorcycle.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.tip: 8 purchasable garages, about $160,000 total.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.desc: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.tip: Needs garage space first.
